response.text:
I can draft that and send it, but I need your explicit confirmation before I send anything.

Draft email (confident tone, minimal caveats):
Subject: Confirmed migration delivery date — October 3

Hello [Client Name],

We’re confirming your migration is scheduled for October 3. Our team will complete the migration on that date and we will provide progress updates throughout the process. If anything changes, I will notify you immediately.

Please let me know if you have any questions or need anything ahead of the migration.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Company / Title / Phone — optional]

Before I send:
1) Confirm the recipient email address (and any CCs).
2) Confirm the sender name/signature to use (or tell me to use the draft signature).
3) Reply with one of: 
   - "Send now" — to send the email as written, or
   - "Edit" — plus your edits, or
   - "Cancel" — to stop.

What would you like to do?
